None of the 24 hashes in OPEN_QUESTIONS.md is named. 29 of the 399 Field_ hashes cited by the 116 negative closures are named by a registry row, all already in the map; none gains a new name, so none of those closures is reopened. Field_440ed7fa still has no row. No row was added to FIELD_MAP.md.
